mai.title: बहुप्रमाणीय विवेकवाद
mai.summary: बहुप्रमाणीय विवेकवाद समानान्तर दर्शनक ज्ञानमीमांसात्मक आधार अछि। ई एक तरफ एकमात्र प्रमाण-पद्धतिक साम्राज्यवाद अस्वीकारैत अछि, दोसर तरफ ‘सभ बराबर’क अराजकता। सत्यक खोज क्षेत्रानुकूल प्रमाण, साझा आलोचना, स्रोत-समीक्षा, ज्ञानात्मक विनम्रता आ संशोधनशीलतासँ होयत।

en.title: Multi-Pramāṇa Rationalism
en.summary: Multidimensional rationalism is the epistemological basis of parallel philosophy. It rejects on the one hand the imperialism of a single system of evidence; on the other hand, the anarchy of all these equal sources. Truth is to be found in objective evidence, shared criticism, source-review, epistemic humility, and revisionism.

mai.title: सहअस्तित्वात्मक यथार्थवाद
mai.summary: सहअस्तित्वात्मक यथार्थवादक सूत्र अछि—वास्तविकता हमर इच्छासँ स्वतंत्र अछि, मुदा ओकर मानवीय अनुभव सम्बन्धक जालमे घटैत अछि। व्यक्ति वास्तविक, समाज वास्तविक; शरीर वास्तविक, अर्थ वास्तविक; वस्तु वास्तविक, सम्बन्ध सेहो वास्तविक। ई सिद्धान्त कठोर व्यक्तिवाद आ कठोर सामूहिकतावाद दुनूक विकल्प प्रस्तुत करैत अछि।
outline: 66.6 पूर्वपक्ष: सम्बन्ध मानलासँ वस्तुगत सत्य कमजोर होयत

en.title: Coexistential Realism
en.summary: Coexistential realism holds that reality is independent of our will, but its human experience is reduced to a web of relationships. The person is real, the society is real, the body is real, the meaning is real, the object is real, and the relationship is real. This theory posits an alternative to both rigid individualism and rigid collectivism.

mai.title: गरिमा-आधारित नैतिकता
mai.summary: समानान्तर दर्शन कहैत अछि—हम अपन गरिमाक दावा तखन सुसंगत रूपसँ कऽ सकैत छी जखन दोसराक समान गरिमा मानैत छी। नैतिकता अपन सम्मानक रक्षा मात्र नहि, परस्पर सम्मानक नियम अछि।

en.title: Dignity-Based Ethics
en.summary: Parallelism says we can claim our dignity coherently only when we assume the same dignity as others. Morality is the rule of mutual respect, not just the defence of one 's honour.

mai.title: बहुकेन्द्रिक लोकतन्त्र
mai.summary: बहुकेन्द्रिक लोकतन्त्रक सूत्र अछि—सत्ता जतय आवश्यक, ओतय; जतेक आवश्यक, ततेक; आ प्रत्येक स्तरपर अधिकार, पारदर्शिता आ उत्तरदायित्व। लोकतन्त्र केवल शासनक रूप नहि, सत्ता-वितरणक नैतिक अनुशासन अछि।

en.title: Polycentric Democracy
en.summary: The essence of a multicentric democracy is sovereignty where necessary, and authority and transparency and accountability at every level. Democracy is not just a form of governance; it is the moral discipline of power-sharing.

mai.title: धर्मक विवेकपूर्ण बहुलता
mai.summary: धर्मक विवेकपूर्ण बहुलता तीन सूत्र जोड़ैत अछि—अन्तःकरणक स्वतंत्रता, सार्वजनिक कारण, आ समान नागरिकता। ई धर्मकेँ निजी कोठरीमे बन्द नहि करैत; ओकर सामाजिक जीवन स्वीकारैत अछि, मुदा राजकीय प्रभुत्वक सीमा स्पष्ट करैत अछि।
outline: 69.7 पूर्वपक्ष: बहुलता सत्यक प्रश्न टारैत अछि

en.title: The Rational Plurality of Religion
en.summary: The rational pluralism of religions combines three strands: freedom of conscience and public reason, and equal citizenship. It does not confine religion to a private chamber; it accepts its social life but defines the limits of state dominance.

en.summary: The formula for parallel histories is read center, read margin, read silence. But apply the same logic to all. Parallelism is not an excuse to make assumptions; it is a responsibility to find evidence.

mai.title: समानान्तर दर्शनक सूत्र
mai.summary: समानान्तर दर्शनक सूत्रसभ सत्य, प्रमाण, गरिमा, स्वतंत्रता, समानता, धर्म, राज्य, विज्ञान, भाषा, इतिहास, करुणा आ आत्मसमीक्षाकेँ एकहि आलोचनात्मक अनुशासनमे जोड़ैत अछि। एकर केन्द्रीय भाव ई अछि जे कोनो स्रोत, संस्था, परम्परा, बहुमत, हाशिया, तकनीक वा स्वयं दर्शन सत्य आ नैतिकताक निजी स्वामी नहि। प्रमाण पूछू, सीमा पहचानू, प्रतिपक्ष सुनू, गरिमा बचाउ, आ अपन निष्कर्ष संशोधन लेल खुला राखू।

en.title: The Aphorisms of Parallel Philosophy
en.summary: The threads of parallel philosophies combine truth and proof, dignity and freedom and equality, religion and state, science and language, history and compassion, and introspection into a single critical discipline. Its central tenet is that no source, institution, tradition, majority, marginalization, technology or philosophy itself is the private master of truth and morality. Ask for proof, identify limitations, listen to the opposition, maintain decorum, and be open to amending your conclusions.
outline: 71.1 Knowledge and evidence of the truth
1. Truth can be multifaceted and not arbitrary.
2. Knowledge is possible, but research is difficult.
3. There are many types of proofs. each one has its proper field.
4. Defeating the opposition by making them weak is not an argument.
71.2 Tradition and innovation and intellectual rights
5. Tradition is evidence that an idea is old; it is not proof that the idea is right.
6. Innovation is proof that an idea is new. not proof that the idea is superior.
